Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lower your hand into the fire without being burned. Shapes gather among the coals: traces of the people and possessions that recently passed its warmth.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One ordinary fire you can touch without harm; 10 minutes
Duration
The result applies when the stated activity is complete; information and earned progress persist.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Utility

The touch is safe only for this divination. Information is limited to the fire’s actual recent history, not distant events. One reading per fire per day. A missing clue cannot be invented.

Weak
Learn whether it was lit within the last day.
Standard
Also learn how many people recently warmed themselves beside it.
Strong
Also glimpse one distinctive item carried by the most recent visitor.
